user.title: Set up StateGuard
user.description: StateGuard monitors labelled entities and devices and alerts you when they go unavailable, stop sending data or cross a threshold. Everything else is configured in the StateGuard panel after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: StateGuard is already set up. Only one instance is needed.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Holds back alerts for a while without turning the watch off.

watch_id.name: Watch
watch_id.description: Limit the snooze to one watch. Leave empty for all watches.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Limit the snooze to one entity. Leave empty for all entities.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Marks a problem as known. No further alerts are sent until it clears.

watch_id.name: Watch
watch_id.description: Limit to one watch. Leave empty for all watches.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Limit to one entity. Leave empty for all entities.

clear_acknowledgement.name: Clear acknowledgement
clear_acknowledgement.description: Undoes an acknowledgement and any active snooze.

watch_id.name: Watch
watch_id.description: Limit to one watch. Leave empty for all watches.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Limit to one entity. Leave empty for all entities.

pause_watch.name: Pause watch
pause_watch.description: Disables a single watch until it is resumed.

run_check.name: Run check
run_check.description: Re-resolves all targets and evaluates every watch immediately.

export_config.name: Export configuration
export_config.description: Returns the complete StateGuard configuration for backup.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Replaces the current configuration with a previously exported one.

config.name: Configuration
config.description: The configuration object as returned by Export configuration.

watch_not_found.message: There is no watch with the id {watch_id}.
